_doc: EA -> MOHAA model swaps (same rules as fl_modelmap.json: only art from the player's own install or the mod's paks; nothing from the disc is shipped). 'trees': a tree-card texture whose card geometry is dropped and a stock 3D tree (BSP static model) is placed at each card cluster: origin at the cluster's trunk foot, scaled so model_height (units above the origin, tiki scale included) matches the card tree, lit with the cards' own mean vertex colour (verts = the model's vertex count), yaw from the spot. trunk_radius (model units, scaled with the tree) adds a solid trunk box up to trunk_height of the tree, skipped within 40u of an AI navpoint. 'trial': applied only when EA_TREE_TRIAL is set.

huO~.reason: [trial 2026-11-13, user asked 'Should we just place a real tree instead?'] the lone bare trees (193 card clusters, 214-403u tall, median 337u) -> the mod's winter common tree (MOHAA commontree mesh, 160 tris, snow-dusted bare branches, its own distance sprite). The disc trees had no collision; the trial adds a trunk box.
